sentences.en: Remember that we will inherit the results of your decisions.
sentences.zh: 记住，你们的决定将会影响到我们的未来。

sentences.en: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
sentences.zh: 温柔的人有福了，因为他们将继承大地。

sentences.en: Sami wanted a son to inherit his name and fortune.
sentences.zh: 萨米想要一个儿子来继承他的名字和财富。

senses.zh: 继承vt.经遗传获得（品质、身体特征等），继任
